title: Tracking Things That Move: A Constant Velocity Filter for Each Object, Association by Distance, and the Three Ways It Goes Wrong

artifact.note: a Kalman filter for a point moving with a nearly constant velocity (position and velocity, with a white acceleration as its process noise), greedy association of detections to tracks within a gate, and a tracker that starts a track on a detection, confirms it after some hits, lets it coast through misses and drops it after too many, and predicts where a track will be
